guidance.quote: finish the year at around INR 8,000 crores, and you need to add... INR 2,000 crores... next year... INR 10,000 crores to INR 12,000 crores

guidance.statement: Copper EBITDA guidance for Q4 FY26 is around INR 600 crore.
guidance.quote: predicting Q4 will be an extremely strong quarter for copper. The demand is very strong, and the EBITDA guidance of INR 600 crore is completely comfortable

achieved.claim: Consolidated business segment EBITDA rose 6% year-on-year to INR 8,762 crores.
India Upstream Aluminum quarterly EBITDA up 14% year-on-year to INR 4,832 crore at $1,572 per ton.
Indian Downstream Aluminum EBITDA up 55% year-on-year to INR 233 crores.
Novelis achieved run-rate exit savings target of $150 million.

pushback.concern: Net debt surged by nearly $2 billion despite high quarterly profitability; clarification sought on reconciliation.
Aluminum EBITDA per ton remained flat over three quarters despite LME prices rising over $300/ton.
Concerns if Hindalco will delay capex programs given Novelis debt surge and fire disruption.
Questioned whether consolidated leverage will exceed 2x given Novelis net debt peaking high.

output.tone_why: Management reaffirmed leverage targets, long-term $600/ton EBITDA guidance, and expected quick post-fire recovery.
